name: far-shore
description: Far Shore, a calm stone-skipping walk across the water. Web app with Capacitor wrappers for Android and iOS.

scripts.add:android: npm run web && cap add android && npm run icons:android
scripts.add:ios: npm run web && cap add ios && npm run icons:ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
